method.decision: For follow-up, an additive arm must gain at least two edit groups from two generator families at each of two adjacent levels. Across levels permit at most one added ordinary group and zero added background-only groups. The same source counts once across levels. Paired dry/early/full transition analyses are diagnostic and do not affect the gate.
method.ladder: For each source compare dry, direct arrival and first 8 ms of response, complete six-second room render, and full room plus the same competing speech at +5, 0, −5 and −10 dB. Preserve the original authored label clock. Match dry/early/full foreground RMS and use the same scalar gain at all stages within the group. Set gain for worst-case peak and independently round and exactly add integer stems. Reuse the same genuine controls at each level.
method.points: Use the earlier mono and AuxIVA points as primary comparison. Before evaluation inference, freeze a second AuxIVA point at the strict maximum from the eight ordinary development readers across all four noisy levels. No positives, evaluation controls or background-only controls enter point fitting. Only the development point stage writes this value.
method.scoring: Use the two pinned two-second windows, speech admission and commercial voice weights. At noisy levels run native mono and both anonymous prior AuxIVA outputs. Select the strongest admitted response per arm and report its exact window. Clean stages use only mono. A useful location exceeds its point, overlaps at least half of a publisher edit and has interval IoU of at least 0.30. Inconclusive inputs are counted separately.
method.sources: Reuse seven exact Aachen publisher edit clips and measured room/background assignments. Reuse 12 known ordinary clips, reserving two per room for point selection before new inference, and add four previously unselected genuine speakers from the same publisher prefix to point selection, two per room. Reserve all six Aachen background-only clips and eight other genuine voices for assessment. These are exposed Aachen cohorts for controlled diagnostics, not fresh release validation.
